decisions.reason: The medical examination light extends the firm's lighting capabilities into an adjacent application where its engineering and in-house R&D still give enough absorptive capacity to learn and improve, though the more specialised medical context raises some withdrawal risk.

The designer task light is very close to the firm's existing knowledge base and was already a relaunch of a known product, so the firm can interpret market feedback well and refine it at relatively low risk.

The pendant office luminaire fits the firm's core commercial-building customer base and established LED lighting expertise, making it a product the firm is well positioned to develop further and keep in the range.

The premium pendant luminaire also builds on familiar lighting knowledge and customer channels, and the multi-model line supports learning across variants, although its more premium positioning adds a little more portfolio risk than a standard office fitting.
